title: Java GHCP Developer
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Java developer focused on building secure, scalable, and resilient
 **RESTful APIs** 
 using
 **Spring Boot** 
 . You’ll work closely with product managers, architects, and DevOps to deliver backend services powering web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate brings strong Java fundamentals, Spring ecosystem experience, and hands\-on API design/implementation skills and with using GitHub CoPilot experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot (Web, Data, Security, Actuator).
* Model and integrate with databases (SQL/NoSQL), write efficient queries, and manage schema migrations
* Implement API security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, role\-based access, rate limiting, input validation.
* Write clean, testable code with unit, integration, and contract tests
* Optimize performance and reliability (caching, connection pooling, async/non\-blocking I/O, pagination).
* Observability: structured logging (SLF4J/Logback), metrics/tracing (Micrometer, OpenTelemetry), and health checks (Actuator).
* CI/CD and cloud deployment (Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, pipelines; Azure exposure a must).
* Collaborate in Agile teams: participate in grooming, estimation, code reviews, and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Own services end‑to‑end: from design and development to deployment and production support (on\-call rotation optional).


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of Java 8\+ (preferably 11/17 or later) and Spring Boot.
* knowledge and experience of using GitHub Copilot
* Experience building RESTful APIs and integrating with external/internal services.
* Solid understanding of data structures, concurrency, and error handling.
* Hands\-on with RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL) and ORMs (JPA/Hibernate).
* Proficient with Git, branching strategies, and Maven/Gradle.
* Familiarity with API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) and Postman/Rest Assured.


**Senior / Lead**
* API architecture \& design (resource modeling, versioning, idempotency, resilience patterns).
* Security best practices (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, secrets management).
* Scalability \& resilience patterns (Circuit Breaker/Retry/Backoff with Resilience4j; async/reactive programming).
* Experience with microservices, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and event\-driven patterns.
* Cloud\-native deployments (Docker/K8s) and IaC (Terraform/Helm is a plus).
* Mentoring developers and leading design/code reviews.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Gravitee** 
 is a
 **2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader** 
 , on a mission to
 **govern the world’s intelligence.**
 We deliver the industry’s most advanced platform for
 **Any API, Any Event, and Any AI Agent** 
 , trusted by global leaders like Michelin, Roche, and Blue Yonder.
   

  

**Why join us?**
* The Mission: We are the first to bridge traditional API Management with the new frontier of AI Agent Security
* The Momentum: A high\-growth Leader \- combining market credibility with startup speed
* The DNA: We hire people who Hold Nothing Back \- passionate builders who want to redefine digital infrastructure


*Don’t just watch the AI revolution. Build the infrastructure that controls and secures it.*
**The Role \& Why It Exists**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Full Stack Developer** 
 who can build robust APIs and intuitive frontend experiences that help our customers understand their data and make better decisions.
   

  

 This is a genuinely full\-stack role. You’ll be comfortable moving between backend and frontend development. Beyond writing code, we’re looking for someone with the engineering judgement expected of a senior developer. Someone who can understand existing architecture, review code effectively, make thoughtful technical decisions, and take ownership of code quality.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 At Gravitee, impact isn't abstract, it's visible. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Develop new features end\-to\-end — from design to implementation, building the APIs and the frontend interfaces and visualizations they power
* Build UI experiences for Gravitee's AI\-related products, including AI Gateway management, agent monitoring, and MCP configuration interfaces
* Contribute to both our open\-source platform and Enterprise Edition
* Use LLMs and AI coding assistants (such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) as a core part of your engineering workflow — for rapid prototyping, code generation, testing, and debugging across the full stack
* Write automated tests to ensure code quality, leveraging AI\-assisted testing tools where appropriate
* Apply engineering judgement to validate and refine AI\-generated outputs, understanding that AI augments but does not replace solid engineering fundamentals
* Collaborate with other engineers and technical leaders to discover the best solutions, and support colleagues through code and design review
* Stay curious about how AI capabilities intersect with API management, and contribute ideas for AI\-powered features


*Your impact will be visible, measurable, and global.*
**Essential Skills**
 The right candidate will possess at least the following skills:
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building full\-stack enterprise web applications
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and React languages
* Genuine full\-stack experience, with the ability and willingness to work across both backend and frontend development
* Strong experience designing, developing, and working with REST/RESTful APIs
* Experience with MongoDB, JDBC, or other relational/database technologies
* Solid understanding of backend architecture, API design, and modern software engineering principles
* Experience with database technologies and data modelling, with the ability to understand and work confidently with database\-backed applications
* Strong code\-review skills and a track record of taking ownership of code quality
* Ability to understand existing architecture and assess the wider impact of code changes rather than working on features in isolation
* Experience with automated testing, Git/GitHub workflows, and agile software development
* Hands\-on experience using LLMs and AI coding assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your engineering workflow
* Strong judgement when working with AI\-generated code. You should be able to understand, validate, correct, and improve generated outputs rather than relying on AI to replace your underlying technical knowledge
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* A curious, adaptable mindset and the ability to learn unfamiliar areas of a complex technical platform


**Desired Skills**
 Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable:
   

  

* Experience with Angular
* Experience with Vert.x
* Knowledge of API management or experience working with API management platforms such as Gravitee, Apigee, MuleSoft, or similar
* Experience with Docker
* Experience with Kubernetes
* Knowledge of Kafka, event streaming, or event\-driven architectures
* Familiarity with OAuth2 and OpenID Connect
* Experience building or testing AI\-powered products, LLM\-based applications, RAG systems, or agentic workflows
* Familiarity with MCP, AI gateways, or related AI infrastructure concepts
* Relevant technical certifications or evidence of continued technical learning


**Who Thrives At Gravitee**
 At Gravitee, our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, act with professionalism in how they work, and hold nothing back in their commitment to doing things well.
   

  

**You'll Do Well Here If You**
* Bring energy — you're friendly, driven, and add to Gravitee's vibrant culture
* Are curious, adaptable, and excited by emerging technologies like AI
* Take ownership and follow through with a sense of urgency
* Thrive in a fast\-paced, agile startup environment
* Are naturally customer\-focused, with a customer\-first mentality


 Bonus points if you've worked with cloud\-native platforms, event streaming, or open source — but curiosity matters most.
   

  

**Life at Gravitee**
 At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles.
   

  

**You’ll Get**
* Competitive medical coverage
* Pension / 401k program options
* Stock options \- you build it, you own it
* 25 days holiday \+ in\-country national holidays
* 3 mental health days \+ wellness allowance
* Your birthday off 🎉
* Professional development budget to fuel your growth
* Hybrid work culture with hubs across regions
* Quarterly team events \+ annual offsite at an exciting location
* A meaningful, progressive, global company culture that is as fun as it is hardworking
* Endless growth opportunities


 At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams.
   

  

 At Gravitee, no employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality or ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, or religion or belief.

title: Software Engineer Global - Observability Accelerators & AI
description:
**Department**
 Technology
   

  

**Our Company Promise**
 We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.
   

  

**Job Description**
 About Us
   

  

 At Southwest Airlines, we believe that flying should feel like freedom. For over 50 years, we’ve been connecting people to what matters most with low fares, legendary hospitality, and a heart for service. Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

**Job Summary**
* Southwest’s Observability Accelerators \& AI Pod develops enterprise observability accelerators and AI\-powered operational tools. The team builds reusable onboarding frameworks, OpenTelemetry deployment patterns, dashboards, migration tooling, agent telemetry, anomaly detection, and investigation capabilities that help engineering teams improve reliability and recover from incidents faster.
* As Software Engineer – Observability Accelerators \& AI, you’ll build, test, and support production\-grade software and cloud\-native AWS solutions using services such as Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and API Gateway. You’ll contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Terraform or CloudFormation configurations, and telemetry experiences across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. You’ll also gain hands\-on experience integrating AI\-enabled skills or agents into observability workflows that improve developer productivity and operational response.
* Design, write program code, test, document, and implement functionally appropriate, technically sound, and well\-integrated application systems in accordance with Customer requirements, organizational methodologies, and standards. Respond to production problems and implement immediate resolution efforts across technology areas.


**Responsibilities**
* Apply knowledge and skills of software development and testing effectively to solve a range of problems
* Work alongside other engineers on the team to elevate technology and consistently apply best practices
* Collaborate closely with customers and cross\-functional departments to communicate project statuses and proposals
* Document each aspect of a system or application as a reference for future upgrades and maintenance
* Determine and assess the needs of the user and then create software to meet the requirements
* Identify and resolve issues that arise during the design, testing and maintenance processes using problem\-solving skills
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software
* Prepare and install solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming
* Mentor junior members on the team
* Improve and expand technical capabilities by continuing their education thru reading, workshops, conferences, and/or communities of practice
* May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Intermediate knowledge of software development methodologies, practices, concepts, and technologies obtained through formal training and / or work experience
* Ability to demonstrate consistent knowledge application, skills of software development, and testing to solve a range of problems
* Intermediate knowledge of at least one required programming language
* Ability to partner, communicate, and negotiate with various Technology or partner Teams
* Ability to analyze and manage large, complex, and vague Business or technical problems, articulating the problem or root cause, and translating the analysis into viable solution recommendations
* Ability to take on multiple assignments, whether administrative or project related, while maintaining a successful level of completion in all responsible work
* Ability to mentor others to do the same
* Ability to develop, present and effectively communicate ideas and strategies to a variety of audiences


 Education
   

  

* Required: Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training


**Experience**
* Required: Intermediate\-level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in software engineering
* 2\-5 years of relevant work\-related experience
* AWS Lambda; Step Functions; EventBridge; SQS; API Gateway; Python or similar; Terraform; CloudFormation; CI/CD; Grafana; CloudWatch; Prometheus; OpenTelemetry; AI skills / agents
* Preferred:
+ Automated testing; machine learning; anomaly detection; SRE; cost optimization


**Other Qualifications**
* Must meet confidentiality expectations as to confidential, proprietary and sensitive Company information
* Ability to work extended hours as needed


***Southwest Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

title: Digital Technology Professional - Software Engineering
description:
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Junior Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. The ideal candidate will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of modern web applications using Angular, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and DBR technologies. This role provides an excellent opportunity to work within an Agile environment while learning from experienced engineers and contributing to business\-critical software products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular.
* Build and enhance RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js.
* Design, write, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL database objects, queries, and stored procedures.
* Contribute to the development and support of solutions built on the DBR technology stack.
* Participate in feature development, bug fixing, code reviews, and testing activities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, UX Designers, QA Engineers, and Senior Developers to deliver high\-quality software.
* Troubleshoot application issues and perform root cause analysis for defects.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following engineering best practices.
* Support CI/CD deployment activities and participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Continuously learn new technologies and contribute ideas for process and product improvements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 0\-2 years of software development experience (internships and academic projects considered).
* Working knowledge of:
* Angular (v12\+ preferred)
* TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
* Node.js and Express.js
* PostgreSQL database development and SQL query optimization
* REST API development and integration
* Git version control
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker.
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.


 Experience working with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot
   

  

**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
   

  

**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
 Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high\-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
   

  

 As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high\-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
   

  

 Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team \- we’d love to have you apply!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.
   

  

**What you’ll achieve:**
* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access\-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source\-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long\-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least\-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI


**About you:**
* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3\+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software\-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access\-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool\-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.

title: Software Engineering Lead - Data Services
description:
Firmable is the market\-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace. Backed by leading investors and 2,000\+ customers, we exist to give sales teams an unfair advantage: the deepest company and people data of any platform, enriched with real\-time signals, served at the right moment by intelligent agents.
 



 The backend services, APIs, and AI systems behind every Firmable product are the engine room. This role owns it.
 



**The Role** 




 As Software Engineering Lead, you'll own the function that designs, builds, and operates the backend services, RESTful APIs, and AI/LLM systems powering every Firmable product. You'll lead two engineering pods through their team leads while staying deeply hands\-on yourself. Reporting to the Head of Data \& Services.
 



 This is not a people\-management seat. \~80% hands\-on architecture and engineering, \~20% leading the function. You whiteboard the system, write the reference implementation, then raise the whole team to that bar. If you want to step away from the code, this isn't it.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Backend and API architecture — Firmable's Python services (FastAPI, Pydantic, Logfire): the secure, well\-documented backbone every product, internal agent, and external customer depends on
* Data modelling — schemas, access patterns, and integrity at scale across PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and DynamoDB
* AI/LLM services and agents — production systems that are fast, idempotent, observable, and cost\-bounded; every LLM call a named, versioned tool with prompts, schemas, traces, and evals
* Harness engineering — the agent runtime the team builds on: tool\-calling and MCP server layers, structured\-output validation, bounded agentic loops, sandboxed execution, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, replayable traces
* Eval harnesses — scorers, labelled sets, trajectory and multi\-turn evals, LLM\-as\-judge calibration, regression suites in CI, drift detection on vendor model updates
* Scale and reliability — systems serving millions of API calls: idempotency, caching, rate limits, cost ceilings, circuit breakers, bounded retries, graceful degradation
* Observability standard — structured traces, p50/p95/p99 by stage, cost per request, and the dashboards that make it legible
* Function leadership — lead and grow two pods through their leads; run architecture and code reviews; set the bar for quality, testing, and AI\-native practice
* Cross\-functional glue — connect Data Platform, Application, and Product; turn early ideas into architecture decisions and working prototypes fast



**What We're Looking For** 




 Must Haves
 


* 7\-10 years hands\-on backend engineering, including time leading engineers or engineering leads with 3\+ years of hands on experience with Python.
* Built and operated large\-scale production systems — millions of API calls, and you know what breaks first when load grows
* Expert Python with deep production experience in FastAPI
* Shipped AI/LLM services, APIs, and agents in production — and stood up the evals that keep them trustworthy
* Harness engineering experience — you've built the scaffolding agents run inside: tool\-calling frameworks, MCP servers, eval and test harnesses other engineers depend on, and you can walk us through it in detail
* Hands\-on data modelling across SQL and NoSQL
* Designed and consumed RESTful services at scale
* Shipped real work with agentic IDEs — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent. Not "tried it" — your default mode
* Lead from the front — whiteboard to reference implementation to a team operating at that standard



 Highly Valued
 


* Eval frameworks (Braintrust, Inspect AI, Promptfoo) and tracing stacks (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)
* Agent frameworks and protocols — Claude Agent SDK, Pydantic AI, LangGraph, MCP
* AWS and/or GCP at scale — ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB
* B2B data, entity resolution, or high\-throughput enrichment pipelines
* Snowflake and modern data\-platform tooling
* Startup or scaleup experience where you shipped fast and owned outcomes end to end



**How We Build** 




 Firmable is an AI\-native organisation. Agentic development, AI\-driven test generation, automated review pipelines, and built\-in evals and traces are the default mode of working, not a productivity experiment. Recurring workflows ship as versioned SKILL.md specs any teammate or agent can run.
 



 We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. You need to be working this way already, and able to bring a team with you.
 



**Why This Role** 



* Own the engine room — you're not joining a team, you're leading the function
* Architectural latitude — the next generation of our services and AI platform is yours to shape
* Hands\-on leadership — the influence of a lead with the satisfaction of still building
* Massive leverage — your work reaches every Firmable customer, every day
* Competitive base \+ meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward



 Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

The candidate is expected to have a strong background in software development and good understanding of systems and networking areas with the knowledge of the WiFi area as an added bonus.
 



 The candidate's role will not be limited to a single aspect of the product, it will be broad encompassing many different aspects including but not limited to developing new Access Points, designing and implementing new features, tracking new technologies and working closely with the sales and customer teams.
 



  





**Requirements:**

**Preferred Skills:**

description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025965
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative, passionate and self\-motivated, we want to hear from you! We are looking for an experienced system engineer, who will play a dual role on the NVIDIA Enterprise Experience (NVEX) team. An awesome candidate is highly technical who can triage customer software issues and resolve customer problems as well as someone who can develop key enhancements and tools for the DGX Platform Software, Container Orchestrators, Deep Learning containers, and potentially other Enterprise related system software.
   

  

 This individual should have proven grasp of platform and systems engineering who understands Linux internals, knowledge about servers and has the ability to resolve hardware and/or OS internal issues. This person will also focus on NVIDIA AI Enterprise SW, a cloud\-native suite of AI and data analytics software optimized for the development and deployment of AI. NVIDIA AI Enterprise is the operating system of the NVIDIA AI platform, essential for applications built with an extensive library of frameworks: NVIDIA® Riva for speech AI, NVIDIA Merlin™ for recommenders, NVIDIA Clara™ for medical imaging, and more. We are also looking for someone who has superb interpersonal and communication skills, given you would be working closely with our customers and engineers to understand, explain and resolve issues, and collaborate with the team to build scalable software. If you have a real passion for technology, and you are interested in a role that you can make a difference in and contribute at all different levels, this may be a phenomenal position for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop features and tools as part of solution engineering efforts to support all Enterprise Service offerings including, but not limited to NGC, Container Orchestrators (such as Kubernetes), GPU accelerated applications, and Deep Learning frameworks.
* Work with NVIDIA Enterprise customers and internal users to improve the availability, reliability, and overall experience of working with NVIDIA servers, system software stack and Deep Learning Framework containers on NVIDIA GPUs.
* Take ownership and drive customer issues on system software components, containers, Deep Learning frameworks, and Cloud deployment from inception to resolution.
* Build upon the opportunity to research new use cases with GPUs for emerging container technologies and Deep Learning frameworks.
* Bring independent analysis, communication, and problem\-solving to customer experience.
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance.


**What We Need To See**
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* At least 5\+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing.
* Intellectual curiosity, positive attitude, flexibility, analytical ability, self\-motivation, and team\-oriented.
* Strong computer science concepts and excellent knowledge of Python and scripting methodologies.
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers, servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers/containerization (ie Docker, Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (ie AWS, GCP).
* You'd have cultivated a deep Linux knowledge, and be very comfortable working in various Linux environments as well as with Windows OS’s.
* Professional\-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Proven experience in developing, triaging and debugging on Linux and Containers and deep learning frameworks.
* Experience working with distributed systems especially container orchestrators.
* Any exposure to system level debug and triaging experience.


 With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world\-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

description:
**Position Overview**
**ABOUT APOLLO**
 Apollo is a high\-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk\-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of March 31, 2025, Apollo had approximately $785 billion of assets under management. . To learn more, please visit www.apollo.com.
   

  

**OUR PURPOSE AND CORE VALUES**
 Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be
   

  

 The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.
   

  

 The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
   

  

 A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.
   

  

 We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:
   

  

 Outperform expectations
   

  

 Challenge Convention
   

  

 Champion Opportunity
   

  

 Lead responsibly
   

  

 Drive collaboration
   

  

 As One Apollo team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.
   

  

**Our Benefits**
 Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Apollo is seeking a quantitative analyst with strong business acumen and exceptional technical skills as part of its Global Quantitative Analytics function (referred to as the Quant function hereafter). The Quant function is responsible for the design, development and maintenance of quantitative tools and the production and support of quantitative metrics across the firm and as such is a critical part of the firm’s business strategy.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will be responsible for validating quant outputs by working through quantitative libraries for risk, valuation and stress for use across Apollo entities. Key asset classes include Structured Credit (vanilla as well as exotic asset backed securities), Derivatives (rates, credit, equity, FX and commodities), public and private equity, and typical fixed income instruments (with or without embedded options) spanning the whole range of credit assets such as corporate bonds, leveraged loans, emerging market debt, private credit, commercial and residential real estate debt, infrastructure debt, convertible bonds, preferred stock, and government bonds.
   

  

 You will leverage your product/markets experience and programming skills to help develop tools that will validate risks appropriately. You will be responsible for working with the Portfolio Managers to model security risks, respond to inquiries, and make recommendations that will ultimately influence investment choices and portfolio construction.
   

  

 In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of daily risk analytics by developing tools to identify any potential issues and by investigating and rectifying any identified issues in the daily risk analytics.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Ensure the accuracy of daily risk analytics by developing tools to identify any potential issues.
* Investigate and rectify any identified issues in the daily risk analytics.
* Utilize existing proprietary model libraries for generating portfolio exposures, stress testing, risk metrics and performance attribution.
* Develop robust quantitative risk and stress models with analytical outputs that fully reflect the key risks of each position and meet the risk management objectives of portfolio managers and senior management.
* Conduct detailed reviews of existing models and propose solutions to enhance the model output.
* Partner with Technology teams to deliver state\-of\-the\-art risk analytics and models.
* Clearly and concisely articulate complex ideas to target audiences including portfolio managers, traders and executive management.
* Build and manage relationships with senior global stakeholders, and with local and regional business leaders, including internal and external parties.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 2\+ years of experience as a Quant in a Front Office Pricing team in large Investment Banks or Asset Managers with focus on traded credit products and Asset Backed Securities. A few years of this experience (but not all) could be in a model validation team validating front office models.
* Deep expertise in credit market dynamics including cash, synthetics, and structured products.
* Strong understanding of quantitative credit methodologies and traded credit analytics.
* Strong conceptual and mathematical knowledge of financial engineering, stochastic modeling, simulation techniques, derivatives pricing, and risk analytics.
* Deep experience in designing risk and valuation models for credit securities, structured products and complex derivatives.
* Proven expertise in stress testing and scenario analysis to assess risk exposures.
* Strong programming skills: Python, R, SQL, and Excel (required) and C/C\+\+ (preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution is required.
* Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, computer science, financial engineering, and econometrics is preferred.
* Practical and hands\-on experience in financial markets.
* Strong communication and diplomatic skills are required to guide, influence, and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently across different businesses and functional areas with thorough attention to detail in a potentially high paced environment.
* Collaborative, organized, flexible and results driven.
* Must have strong drive and initiative, be collaborative to effectively liaise with senior stakeholders and colleagues.
* A forward thinking, creative individual who challenges the status quo and takes initiative to reengineer processes.
* Strong project management skills
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to resolve conflict and observe confidentiality.
* Be nimble and flexible to balance multiple tasks simultaneously.


*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. description:

* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.

* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).

As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.

title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:

 ReliaQuest’s Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test\-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms.
   

  

 This is a code\-first, automation\-focused engineering role—not a manual testing or documentation\-only position. You will gain hands\-on experience with production\-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI\-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles.
   

  

 The everyday hustle:
   

  

* Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services.
* Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation.
* Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines.
* Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments.
* Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues.
* Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre\-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling.
* Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services.
* Use Claude and other AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation.
* Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Carefully validate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations.
* Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team.
* Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur.


 Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes.
* Familiarity with Git and branch\-based development workflows.
* A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments.
* An automation\-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions.
* Working knowledge of Claude or similar AI\-assisted engineering tools and an understanding of how they can support test design, automation, debugging, failure analysis, and productivity.
* The judgment to validate, refine, and correct AI\-generated recommendations rather than accepting them without review.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting defects and collaborating with technical teams.
* A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn through training, pairing, and feedback.


 What makes you uncommon?
   

  

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated quality gates.
* Experience with test automation frameworks or API testing tools.
* Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or mobile automation technologies.
* Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, metrics, or monitoring tools.
* Exposure to production or staging incidents and root\-cause investigation.
* Experience using AI tools to generate or improve automation scripts, test cases, API scenarios, or debugging workflows.
* Familiarity with prompt\-writing techniques for technical work such as log analysis, code explanation, test coverage review, and root\-cause analysis.
* An interest in improving shared automation platforms, developer tooling, and organization\-wide Quality Engineering practices.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity \& Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data\-driven solutions.
 



 We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end\-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.
 



 In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.
 








**What will you do in this role?** 



* Business Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non\-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data\-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert \& Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance \& Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end\-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.



  





**What do you need to succeed in this role?** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API\-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.

description:

 Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
   

  

 In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects
+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end\-to\-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master\-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field\-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi\-org, multi\-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest\-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise\-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 10\-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5\+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H\&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI\-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

 Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation including solution design notes, process logic, code commenting, SOPs, testing evidence, version histories, and user guidance to ensure sustainable ownership and supportability.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Coveo Search
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer \- Coveo Search to help design, build, integrate, and optimize Agilent’s Coveo\-powered search experiences across Agilent.com, Community, eCommerce, content discovery, and connected digital experiences. In this role, you will own the technical implementation of Coveo integrations, query pipelines, analytics\-driven relevancy improvements, merchandising rules, AI/ML models, and data ingestion pipelines that power customer discovery, self\-service, and conversion. You will partner closely with experience, content, commerce, data, analytics, and platform teams to ensure Coveo delivers highly relevant, permission\-aware, measurable, and scalable search experiences across products, documents, communities, recommendations, and support journeys.
   

  

 This role currently follows a hybrid work model. Work arrangements may evolve based on future business needs.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Work with a team of engineers to deliver Coveo search capabilities that are crucial to digital revenue growth, customer self\-service, product discovery, and content findability.
* Be part of a world class global organization building intelligent search experiences across Agilent.com, Community, eCommerce, content hubs, support journeys, and future AI\-enabled experiences.
* Design, build, configure, and support Coveo integrations across search interfaces, query pipelines, sources, indexes, APIs, permissions, analytics, and experience\-layer components.
* Partner with Experience layer teams to integrate Coveo search, filtering, recommendations, and generated\-answer capabilities into Agilent.com and Community user experiences.
* Implement and tune merchandising rules, boost/bury logic, redirect rules, facet behavior, ranking expressions, synonyms, thesaurus rules, and business\-driven search controls.
* Support eCommerce search use cases including product discovery, catalog search, product recommendations, category/listing pages, guided search, and search\-to\-cart journeys.
* Support content discovery use\-cases including document libraries, technical documentation, application notes, knowledge articles, community content, blogs, wikis, media, and entitled content.
* Use Coveo analytics and Snowflake\-connected analytics data to identify content gaps, zero\-result queries, click\-through trends, query\-suggestion adoption, generated\-answer engagement, and relevancy improvement opportunities.
* Configure and improve Coveo models such as Query Suggestions, Automatic Relevance Tuning, Dynamic Navigation, Semantic Encoder, Relevance Generative Answering, and recommendation models where applicable.
* Design and support AWS\-based ETL and data pipelines that extract, transform, normalize, enrich, and push structured and unstructured data into Coveo indexing pipelines.
* Collaborate with product, content, analytics, data engineering, platform, and business teams to continuously tune search results, improve relevancy, and increase measurable customer outcomes.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6\+ years of relevant software engineering experience with search platforms, digital commerce platforms, content platforms, data integrations, or enterprise web applications.
* Hands\-on experience with Coveo platform capabilities including sources, indexes, query pipelines, search APIs, usage analytics, permissions, machine learning models, and administration.
* Strong understanding of Coveo integrations with front\-end experience layers, including headless/API\-based search implementations, search boxes, result templates, facets, filters, analytics events, and user context.
* Experience with eCommerce search and merchandising concepts including product ranking, boost/bury rules, redirects, synonyms, recommendations, catalog search, product attributes, category pages, and conversion\-focused tuning.
* Experience supporting content search across structured and unstructured sources such as documents, knowledge articles, application notes, community posts, blogs, wikis, media, product content, and entitled content.
* Ability to analyze Coveo usage analytics and Snowflake\-connected analytics datasets to identify search quality issues, content gaps, poor performing queries, click behavior, and optimization opportunities.
* Experience configuring, evaluating, and improving Coveo AI/ML models such as Query Suggestions, Automatic Relevance Tuning, Dynamic Navigation, Semantic Encoder, Relevance Generative Answering, and recommendation models.
* Strong knowledge of data ingestion, indexing, metadata mapping, normalization, enrichment, permissions, incremental updates, delta processing, and content freshness patterns for search platforms.
* Experience with AWS\-based ETL and data engineering patterns using services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, APIs, databases, and scheduled or event\-driven pipelines.
* Programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar languages used for search integrations, APIs, pipeline processing, automation, and data transformation.
* Solid understanding of SDLC, agile delivery, CI/CD, automated validation, observability, production support, and release management for enterprise digital platforms.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, analytical mindset, attention to detail, and ability to translate search analytics into technical and business improvements.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative perspective across engineering, product, merchandising, content, analytics, and business stakeholders.
* Experience using generative AI and analytics\-assisted approaches to improve search relevance, content discoverability, answer quality, and customer self\-service outcomes.


**Ways to stand out:**
* Ability to fully utilize agentic development techniques, including AI\-assisted coding, automated test generation, code review support, documentation acceleration, and workflow automation, to improve engineering efficiency, delivery speed, and overall development quality.
* Deep Coveo implementation experience across both commerce and content search, including query pipeline design, model tuning, merchandising, analytics, and experience\-layer integration.
* Experience connecting Coveo analytics with Snowflake or enterprise data platforms to build dashboards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous relevancy improvement.
* Experience designing AWS ETL pipelines that support search ingestion, metadata enrichment, permissions, incremental synchronization, bulk updates, and reliable production operations.
* Experience integrating search into large\-scale B2B eCommerce, customer community, support, documentation, or enterprise self\-service experiences.


**Additional Details**
 This job has a full time weekly schedule.

description:

**About JAGGAER**
 JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
   

  

 Our 1,300\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Associate Manager, Web Developer will own the core architecture, custom development, technical health,
   

  

 security, and performance of our global web properties. This person will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable WordPress themes and plugins, ensuring seamless API integrations, maintaining airtight security, and delivering exceptional front\-end performance across all regions, pages, and business units.
   

  

 This role will lead technical implementation for web projects, engineer custom Gutenberg blocks, optimize core infrastructure, troubleshoot complex code issues, and partner closely with demand generation, SEO, UX/UI design, marketing operations, and external engineering partners.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on code owner, highly skilled in modern PHP and JavaScript, obsessed with Web Vitals, and capable of translating marketing goals into high\-performing, maintainable code.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
**Custom WordPress Development \& Engineering**
* Design and engineer custom, high\-performing WordPress themes and plugins from scratch using modern PHP, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and SCSS/CSS.
* Build modular, editor\-friendly custom Gutenberg blocks using React and native block APIs to empower non technical content managers.


**Website Management \& Development**
* Own the day\-to\-day management, maintenance, and technical performance of the corporate website.
* Build, update, edit, and publish website pages within the CMS.
* Make front\-end code changes using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Understand and troubleshoot back\-end website functionality, CMS architecture, templates, plugins, APIs, databases, and integrations.
* Develop or modify reusable website components, templates, landing pages, forms, navigation elements, and other site functionality.
* Ensure new website functionality is implemented cleanly and consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences.
* Review and troubleshoot code when website functionality, styling, forms, tracking, or integrations are not working as expected.


**Technical Website Troubleshooting**
* Proactively identify, diagnose, and resolve technical website errors.
* Investigate and resolve issues across front\-end, back\-end, CMS, hosting, integrations, analytics, and performance.
* Use browser developer tools, error logs, monitoring platforms, and debugging tools to identify root causes.
* Coordinate with hosting providers, developers, IT, security teams, and third\-party vendors when deeper technical support is required.
+ Broken pages or components
+ JavaScript errors
+ CSS and responsive design issues
+ Form submission problems
+ CMS or plugin conflicts
+ Redirect errors
+ 404 and 5xx errors
+ Broken links
+ API or third\-party integration failures
+ Tracking and analytics implementation problems
+ Server or hosting\-related issues
+ Website caching issues
+ Website performance degradation


**Website Performance \& Technical SEO**
* Monitor and improve website speed, accessibility, usability, and overall technical health.
* Support Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile performance, and site architecture improvements.
* Partner with SEO teams to implement technical SEO recommendations.
* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues across crawling, indexation, redirects, rendering, metadata, and structured data.
* Support implementation and validation within Google Search Console and other SEO monitoring platforms.
+ Indexation problems
+ Crawl errors
+ Redirect chains
+ Canonical issues
+ Robots.txt and XML sitemap issues
+ Structured data/schema markup
+ Duplicate content
+ Broken internal links
+ Page rendering issue.


**CMS \& Website Infrastructure**
* Serve as a technical owner and administrator of the website CMS.
* Manage CMS users, permissions, templates, plugins, themes, modules, and website configurations.
* Maintain development, staging, and production website environments.
* Support website releases, deployments, migrations, and QA processes.
* Manage or coordinate website backups, updates, patches, and version control.
* Understand DNS, SSL certificates, domains, CDN configuration, hosting environments, and website infrastructure.
* Help maintain website security and identify vulnerabilities or outdated software.


**Marketing Technology \& Integrations**
* Work closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, SEO, Content, Analytics, and IT teams.
* Support integrations between the website and CRM, marketing automation, analytics, tag management, form platforms, chat tools, consent management platforms, and third\-party APIs.
* Troubleshoot issues related to lead capture, form routing, tracking, attribution, and website\-to\-CRM integrations.
* Support implementation of analytics and marketing tracking including Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, and campaign tracking.


**Content \& Website Operations**
* Partner with marketing and content teams to publish new pages, campaigns, resources, and website updates.
* Ensure content updates follow brand, UX, accessibility, SEO, and technical standards.
* Manage website requests and prioritize changes based on business impact.
* Conduct QA before and after website releases.
* Maintain documentation covering website architecture, technical processes, integrations, templates, and recurring maintenance.


**Position Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in website management, web development, web operations, or a similar technical website role.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience managing and developing within an enterprise CMS, preferably WordPress or a comparable platform.
* Strong understanding of both front\-end and back\-end website architecture.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical website problems independently and determine root causes.
* Experience working with APIs, plugins, website integrations, and third\-party services.
* Understanding of web hosting, DNS, CDN, SSL, caching, server environments, and website deployment processes.
* Experience using browser developer tools and debugging website errors.
* Strong knowledge of responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Understanding of technical SEO and website performance optimization.
* Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, or similar digital platforms.
* Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
* Strong QA discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to translate technical website issues into clear explanations for non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting a large\-scale B2B, SaaS, or enterprise website.
* Experience with PHP, SQL, React, Node.js, or other web development technologies.
* Experience working with WordPress themes, plugins, custom post types, and PHP templates.
* Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
* Experience with website hosting platforms such as WP Engine, Kinsta, or similar enterprise hosting providers.
* Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and development/staging/production environments.
* Experience with accessibility standards, including WCAG.
* Experience with website security, vulnerability management, and performance monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar technologies.

**Our Values \- T.E.A.M**
 At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.
   

  

  

  

* Transparency \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics\-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.
